q: Do ferroalloys from Zestaponi face CBAM in the EU?
title: Zestaponi ferroalloys: CBAM check
short: It depends on the alloy. Ferro-manganese (CN 7202 1) is covered by CBAM; silico-manganese (7202 30) is not. Check the CN code on each shipment, and for covered alloys send direct emissions from coke, coal and electrodes per tonne.
audience: Ferroalloy makers in Georgia and EU steel mills buying their alloys

ul: Ferro-silicon and other 7202 alloys: not covered.

p: Direct emissions come from the carbon in coke, coal and electrode paste, worked out by mass balance, divided by tonnes of alloy. Electricity is reported, not charged.
EU steel mills still ask for a figure for their own Scope 3. Keep the same records either way.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
